scenes.title: The Broken Paradigm
scenes.focus: Over 95% of bank AML alerts are false positives, burying investigators in noise.
scenes.narration: Banks move trillions across wire, ACH, card, and crypto. But traditional rules trigger over ninety-five percent false positives. Laundering is connected, yet investigators waste hours manually stitching fragmented systems together.

scenes.title: Governed Ingestion & Quality Gates
scenes.focus: 20+ automated data-quality rules hold dirty batches before scoring.
scenes.narration: Everything starts with governed data. TraceLayer runs twenty automated data-quality rules on raw feeds, catching schema drift and malformed amounts. Bad batches are quarantined, and every transaction keeps an immutable link to its source CSV row.

scenes.title: Leakage-Free AI & Benchmark SOTA
scenes.focus: Discovering future data leakage in SOTA research and building strictly causal point-in-time models.
scenes.narration: We audited published benchmarks and discovered a major future data leak. When frozen properly, the paper model crashed from forty-seven to twelve. We engineered strictly causal point-in-time features, achieving forty-five AUPRC on XGBoost and sixty-one on our temporal graph neural network.

scenes.title: 7ms Time-Respecting Graph Engine
scenes.focus: Chronological money-flow graph highlighting detected layering chains in bold red.
scenes.narration: Our in-memory graph engine traces time-respecting money paths and cycles. Across two hundred eighty thousand transactions, it recovered fifty-nine of sixty injected layering chains in just seven milliseconds, illuminating the full laundering route in vivid red.

scenes.title: Multi-Agent Copilot with 9-Rule Verifier
scenes.focus: Local LLM narrative synthesis verified by nine mathematical invariant checks.
scenes.narration: Investigations run on bounded LangGraph multi-agent workflows. A local air-gapped language model writes the narrative synthesis, which is immediately checked by a nine-rule deterministic verifier validating every dollar amount, account ID, and timestamp against ground truth.

scenes.title: Four-Eyes Review & Cryptographic Audit
scenes.focus: Mandatory human supervisory sign-off and append-only database audit receipts.
scenes.narration: AI assists, but human compliance officers always make the final call. Every supervisory sign-off produces an Ed25519 hash-chained cryptographic receipt stored in an append-only audit log that mathematically refuses updates or deletions.

scenes.title: See the Whole Path. Trust Every Number.
scenes.focus: TraceLayer: The governed financial-crime intelligence layer.
scenes.narration: TraceLayer connects financial-crime signals to the governed evidence behind them. See the whole path, trust every number, and empower human compliance.
